intent.proves: Product relations (accessories, spare parts, replacements): relations-resolve satisfies the selected profile assertion.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.query: SELECT TOP 25 CAST(r.ProductRelatedProductId AS nvarchar(50)) + N' -> ' + CAST(r.ProductRelatedProductRelId AS nvarchar(50)) + N' in ' + CAST(r.ProductRelatedGroupId AS nvarchar(50)) FROM EcomProductsRelated r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomProducts p WHERE p.ProductId = r.ProductRelatedProductId) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomProducts p WHERE p.ProductId = r.ProductRelatedProductRelId) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomProductsRelatedGroups g WHERE g.RelatedGroupId = r.ProductRelatedGroupId)
